title: Visual supervision targets
caption: Aligned agent and wrist views from a LIBERO demonstration. These are simulator-derived training targets, not GenPA predictions; the deployed policy receives RGB observations, not these target maps.
task_instruction: Pick up the milk and place it in the basket.

source.source_note: Existing original 256 × 256 panels used in the manuscript; image pixels are unchanged.

targets.label: Current depth
targets.description: Optical-axis depth is encoded in grayscale with a fixed log-inverse mapping: nearer surfaces are brighter.
targets.legend: The preview is a rounded display of a floating-point training target, not raw depth in meters. The fixed LIBERO mapping clips depths to 0.04–3.5 m and is shared across frames and cameras.

targets.label: Surface normals
targets.description: RGB encodes the X, Y, and Z components of surface normals in the camera coordinate frame.
targets.legend: Camera axes are +X right, +Y down, and +Z forward; normals are oriented toward the camera. Each component maps from −1…+1 to 0…255. Black marks excluded or invalid neighborhoods, not a surface orientation.

targets.label: Robot-frame pointmaps
targets.description: RGB encodes the X, Y, and Z coordinates of visible surface points in the robot-base frame.
targets.legend: The fixed coordinate encoding is shared across frames and cameras. Central X/Y/Z intervals are [−0.25,1.00], [−0.45,0.50], and [−0.10,0.50] m, mapped to codes 16…240, with smooth tails outside these intervals. Black marks invalid points; these colors are coordinates, not object classes.

targets.label: Semantic-part segmentation
targets.description: A fixed color palette identifies semantic parts throughout the scene, including objects, robot parts, and articulated parts.
targets.legend: The 37-class ontology and palette are shared across all four LIBERO suites and both cameras; same-class instances share a color. This is task-independent semantic labeling, not per-instance random coloring.

targets.label: Task-conditioned grounding
targets.description: RGB marks the operation object, goal or anchor, and active articulated part for the current demonstration stage.
targets.legend: Red = operation object; green = goal or anchor; blue = active articulated part. Roles are independent and overlapping roles blend colors. Black = no assigned role at that pixel. In this example the agent view shows red milk and green basket; the wrist view shows only red milk. No blue active-part pixels appear in either view.

targets.label: Future RGB
targets.description: The RGB target shows the demonstration scene 16 retained action steps into the future, using the current RGB observation as reference.
targets.legend: The offset counts retained steps after no-op filtering, not necessarily original simulator frames; the target clips to the final retained frame near the trajectory end.

targets.label: Future depth
targets.description: The depth target uses the same future state as Future RGB and the same fixed depth encoding as Current depth.
targets.legend: Future depth is one supervision task, not the combination of current depth and future RGB. Its PNG is a rounded display preview of the floating-point target.

display_notes: Use the same image scale for reference and target panels; do not apply per-image contrast normalization.
Do not add a linear metric-depth colorbar to the grayscale previews. A short Nearer → brighter legend is sufficient.
Keep target colors unchanged; normals, pointmaps, semantic parts, and grounding have different color meanings.
Future RGB and future depth share one future source state.
